zh.title: 華航與維珍大西洋深化天合聯盟合作　列載倫敦—首爾共掛班號
zh.summary: 同屬天合聯盟的中華航空與維珍大西洋航空進一步落實共掛班號合作，初期列載維珍執飛的倫敦希斯洛—首爾仁川航線，最快自10月7日起實施。
body: 同屬天合聯盟（SkyTeam）的中華航空與維珍大西洋航空，進一步透過共掛班號拓展合作。根據航空航線資訊媒體AeroRoutes報導，雙方合作航班資料已開始列載，預定最快自2026年10月7日起實施，初期涵蓋維珍大西洋航空執飛的倫敦希斯洛機場（LHR）至首爾仁川國際機場（ICN）往返航線。
倫敦飛往首爾的VS208航班將加掛華航CI9288班號；首爾返回倫敦的VS209航班則加掛CI9289班號。目前列載班表顯示，兩個方向均每日營運，由波音787-9客機執飛。共掛班號讓同一班航班以不同航空公司的班號銷售，實際飛航仍由維珍大西洋航空負責。
華航已於2026年9月16日、加入天合聯盟15週年之際，宣布與維珍大西洋航空簽署共掛班號協議，初期安排在部分維珍大西洋執飛航班上加掛華航班號。此次倫敦—首爾航線的列載，是兩家聯盟成員將合作落實至具體航線的進展，也延續華航透過天合聯盟夥伴拓展航網的布局。後續是否增加其他共掛航線，仍待進一步公布。

en.title: China Airlines and Virgin Atlantic Deepen SkyTeam Cooperation With London–Seoul Codeshare
en.summary: China Airlines and Virgin Atlantic are moving forward with a new codeshare arrangement on Virgin-operated London Heathrow–Seoul Incheon flights, with implementation listed from as early as October 7, 2026.
body: China Airlines and Virgin Atlantic, both members of SkyTeam, are expanding their cooperation through a codeshare arrangement. According to route-information outlet AeroRoutes, the partnership has begun appearing in schedule data and is expected to take effect as early as October 7, 2026, initially covering Virgin Atlantic-operated services between London Heathrow Airport (LHR) and Seoul Incheon International Airport (ICN).

Virgin Atlantic flight VS208 from London to Seoul will also carry China Airlines flight number CI9288, while the return VS209 from Seoul to London will carry CI9289. Current schedule listings show both directions operating daily with Boeing 787-9 aircraft. Under the codeshare arrangement, the same physical flight can be marketed under different airline flight numbers, while Virgin Atlantic remains the operating carrier.

China Airlines announced on September 16, 2026, the 15th anniversary of its joining SkyTeam, that it had signed a codeshare agreement with Virgin Atlantic. The initial plan was to place China Airlines flight numbers on selected Virgin Atlantic-operated services. The London–Seoul listing marks a concrete step in implementing that agreement and continues China Airlines' strategy of expanding network reach through SkyTeam partners. Whether additional codeshare routes will be added has yet to be announced.
